summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests Vyxeos (a liposomal form of cytarabine and daunorubicin) given with gilteritinib in adults with relapsed or refractory FLT3-mutated acute myeloid leukemia. Vyxeos is given as an intravenous infusion over 90 minutes on days 1, 3 and 5 of induction, and gilteritinib is taken by mouth daily on days 6 to 19 of induction. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is a Phase 1 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa Vyxeos (una forma liposomal de citarabina y daunorrubicina) administrado junto con gilteritinib en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda recidivante o refractaria con mutación FLT3. Vyxeos se administra como infusión intravenosa durante 90 minutos los días 1, 3 y 5 de la inducción, y el gilteritinib se toma por vía oral todos los días del 6 al 19 de la inducción. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase 1.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older with FLT3-ITD or FLT3-TKD mutated AML (non-M3).
AML that has relapsed or not responded to at least one prior AML treatment.
ECOG performance status of 2 or better.
Left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% or higher.
Able to take oral medication and follow the medication plan.
not_for: Documented central nervous system involvement of AML.
AML that progressed while on prior gilteritinib therapy.
White blood cell count of 50,000 or higher when study treatment begins.
Grade 3 or higher graft versus host disease after transplant.
Other cancers needing current treatment, with listed exceptions.
